envelope.description: Queue the index request in the codeReview.freshness handler

body.title: Queue the index request in the codeReview.freshness handler
body.summary: In src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts keep an in-memory request map for the codeReview.freshness handler, supply requestedAt from it, queue one 'file' job (event update) for each file in unindexedFiles with its request time recorded, and re-read the queue state so the same reply shows the work. If buildHandlerRuntime cannot be driven with fake dependencies, put the request step in a small function that takes the queue, the request map and the compute result and have the handler call it; that extraction is then the only production change beyond the handler. Add src/daemon/__tests__/code-review-freshness-request.test.ts (the handler or that function with a recording queue; the real selection seam with the indexer parsers registered) and a contract case in src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/__tests__/handler.test.ts for a stale file with an idle queue in a mixed set.
acceptanceChecks: The request step queues one file job for each file in unindexedFiles, queues nothing for a second identical poll, and queues again after the file's mtime moves
After queueing, the same reply carries isProcessing, inFlight and pendingCodeIndexJobs read from the queue after the jobs were queued

The real selection seam returns not-code for a .png and package-lock.json, excluded-by-ignore for a .ts under node_modules, and selected for a .ts and a small .md; a nonexistent changed .ts path is not stale and queues nothing while an existing entity-less .ts file is stale and queued once

With proceed true and a freshness that keeps reporting one stale file with an idle queue while other files have symbols, the wait ends at the freshness time-out in the degraded diff review and no full review runs
src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts and the routing, long-review, RPC fallback and review-stream-freshness tests pass unchanged
